description: Report a bug or issue to the OneSource team. Use when a tool returns an unexpected error or when the user asks to report a problem. Free, no payment required.

description.description: What went wrong — describe the bug, what you expected, and what actually happened.

error_message.description: The error message or relevant output from the failed tool call.

network.description: The blockchain network involved, if applicable (e.g. ethereum, sepolia).

severity.description: Bug severity: low (cosmetic), medium (degraded function), high (feature broken), critical (server crash or data loss).

steps_to_reproduce.description: Steps to reproduce the issue, if known.

tool_name.description: The MCP tool that produced the error (e.g. 1s_network_info, 1s_erc20_balance_live).

name: 1s_report_bug
title: Report Bug
